title: tab/dialog
description: Engine-to-shell notification: the page needs an answer the shell shows as its own Visual Studio-style dialog (never Chromium's): JavaScript `alert`, `confirm` and `prompt` (CefJSDialogHandler::OnJSDialog), a page asking to confirm leaving (`beforeunload`, OnBeforeUnloadDialog), a file chooser (`<input type=file>`, CefDialogHandler::OnFileDialog) or an HTTP authentication challenge (CefRequestHandler::GetAuthCredentials). The page waits until tab/dialogAnswer answers it (the engine's callback is held, not run), or until the engine closes it on its own (the tab navigates or closes), which tab/dialogClosed reports. One dialog per tab at a time.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

id.description: The dialog's id, unique in the engine process (shared with tab/permission's ids); the answer names it.

message.description: `alert`, `confirm`, `prompt`, `beforeunload`: the page's text (for `beforeunload`, Chromium's own sentence: pages cannot set it). `file`: the chooser's title, when the page set one.

defaultText.description: `prompt`: the default value of the text box.

url.description: The origin of the page (alert, confirm, prompt) or the url asking for credentials (auth).

isReload.description: `beforeunload`: the page is being reloaded rather than left.

mode.description: `file`: open one file, several, a folder, or save.

accept.description: `file`: the accept filters of the input (`image/*`, `.txt`, ...).

defaultPath.description: `file`: the suggested file name or path.

isProxy.description: `auth`: a proxy asks, not the site.
